card.text: Icy moon of Jupiter whose ocean may hold twice the water of Earth's oceans.

introduction.text: Dark, reddish-brown cracks cross Europa's ice shell. Its few craters suggest a young surface.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Galileo close-ups add detail to the global mosaic, evened for Sun angle. Original shadows remain; gray grid marks gaps.

sources.label: USGS · Galileo SSI
sources.locator: Processing; Accuracy, Errors, and Issues; General Usability

enhanced.title: SSI false-color mosaic
enhanced.summary: False color from 756, 559 and 404 nm bands over monochrome detail; monochrome remains where color is missing.

geology.title: USGS global geology (2024 SIM 3513)
geology.summary: Interpreted plains, bands, chaos and crater units from the 2024 USGS map. Lines and point features are left out.

infrared.title: Galileo NIMS spectral color
infrared.summary: False color from 1.50, 1.34 and 0.73 µm NIMS bands: spectral differences, not natural color or mineral amounts.

carbon-dioxide.title: NIRSpec 4.26 µm band depth
carbon-dioxide.summary: JWST CO₂ absorption across eight observations. About 300 km resolution.

hydrogen-peroxide.title: NIRSpec 3.50 µm band depth
hydrogen-peroxide.summary: The 3.50 µm feature has a disputed instrumental contribution. About 300 km resolution.

sodium-chloride.title: STIS 450 nm absorption
sodium-chloride.summary: Hubble absorption band interpreted as irradiated salt. Compare spatial patterns.

junocam.title: JunoCam 2022 flyby mosaic
junocam.summary: Four calibrated photographs retain their observed coverage and illumination.
